item.title: Berlinan 1.2.8
item.description:
• Automatic updates: at launch Berlinan checks whether a new version is out and offers it with its release notes; after you click Install Update it downloads, verifies and installs it and restarts. Switch the check off in Berlinan ▸ Settings… (⌘,); Check for Updates… in the app menu checks by hand.
  • Readability: labels are brighter (contrast at least 4.5:1) and the performance panel wraps onto two or three rows instead of cutting controls short in narrower windows.
